ActivitiesResponse.description: Paginated activity feed of the authenticated AniList user.
ActivitiesResponse.title: ActivitiesResponse

ActivityReplyResponse.description: A single reply, shared by the list, create and delete endpoints.
ActivityReplyResponse.title: ActivityReplyResponse

AnimeDetailsResponse.description: Full detail of a single anime (``GET /api/v1/animes/{anime_id}``).
AnimeDetailsResponse.title: AnimeDetailsResponse

AnimeListEntryItem.description: One entry of a media list as returned by the list endpoints.
AnimeListEntryItem.title: AnimeListEntryItem

AnimeListEntryResponse.description: Result of updating a media list entry (``SaveMediaListEntry``).
AnimeListEntryResponse.title: AnimeListEntryResponse

AnimeListResponse.description: Paginated media list of the authenticated user.
AnimeListResponse.title: AnimeListResponse

AvailableToWatchResponse.description: Entries of the current list that already have an unwatched episode.
AvailableToWatchResponse.title: AvailableToWatchResponse

AvatarResponse.description: Avatar urls shared by profile, activities and replies payloads.
AvatarResponse.title: AvatarResponse

ErrorResponse.description: Body of every error response produced by the API.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

LikeableType.description: AniList ``LikeableType`` — target accepted by the ToggleLike mutation.
LikeableType.title: LikeableType

MeResponse.description:
Authenticated user, in a single shape for both cases below.

``exists`` is ``False`` when the app has a valid JWT but no matching row in
``users`` (the token was issued before the account row was removed).
MeResponse.title: MeResponse

MediaListStatus.description: AniList ``MediaListStatus`` — status of an entry in the user's list.
MediaListStatus.title: MediaListStatus

PageInfoResponse.description: AniList ``PageInfo`` block, exposed as-is by every paginated endpoint.
PageInfoResponse.title: PageInfoResponse

ToggleLikeResponse.description: Result of liking/unliking an activity or a reply.
ToggleLikeResponse.title: ToggleLikeResponse

UserProfileResponse.description: Public profile of the authenticated AniList account (``/me/profile``).
UserProfileResponse.title: UserProfileResponse

ViewerResponse.description: The AniList account behind the current app session (``/me/viewer``).
ViewerResponse.title: ViewerResponse
